title: Parallel timers: track time on more than one task at once
summary: Real work overlaps. You're answering a message while a build runs, or half-listening to a meeting while you finish a doc.

Real work overlaps. You're answering a message while a build runs, or half-listening to a meeting while you finish a doc. Until now, starting a timer stopped every other timer. Now it doesn't have to.


How it works:


- Mark a task as Parallel, and you can run its timer alongside other Parallel tasks' timers.
- Time is split evenly between the timers that are running. Two timers each log half of the elapsed time, and three each log a third. Stop one, and the rest speed back up.
- Tasks that aren't Parallel (Focused, the default) still work as before. Starting a Focused timer pauses the Parallel ones, and starting a Parallel one pauses the Focused one.
- Nothing changes unless you opt in by marking a task Parallel.


Tried it? Tell us what you'd change, or what's missing, in the comments below or reach out in support!
